question: The following entities may be accompanied by ocular inflammation (uveitis) except one. Indicate which:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Sarcoidosis -> possible ocular inflammation (uveitis) -> 80% CHAIN: Juvenile idiopathic arthritis -> possible ocular inflammation (uveitis) -> 80% CHAIN: Behçet's disease -> ocular inflammation (uveitis) -> 100% CHAIN: Marfan's disease -> possible ocular complications, but not typically uveitis -> 70% CHAIN: Multiple sclerosis -> possible ocular complications, but not typically uveitis -> 80%
analysis: Uveitis can be associated with various systemic conditions, but it is not typically seen in Marfan's disease. The other options listed are known to be associated with ocular inflammation.
